title: Derivative of the affine moment derivative
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $r,c\in\mathbb R$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Define $F(t)$ as the average over $x\in\Omega$ of $rcX(x)(1+ctX(x))^{r-1}$, and define $G(t)$ as the average of $r(r-1)c^2X(x)^2(1+ctX(x))^{r-2}$. At any $t\in\mathbb R$ for which $1+ctX(x)>0$ for every $x\in\Omega$, the function $F$ is differentiable at $t$ with derivative $G(t)$.
